{{Top|leg}}
The '''Microparticle Ion Accelerator''',<ref name="SBB:XVT">''[[Starfighter Battle Book: X-wing vs TIE Interceptor]]''</ref> also known as an '''ion-stream projector''',<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> was the center-piece of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. The Accelerator was fed super-charged ions gathered from [[solar gather-panel]]s, accelerating them to near [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] before sending them through [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsor fields]] and out the [[Twin-Port Ion Stream Exhaust Vent]] to provide reaction thrust.<ref name="SBB:XVT" />
